caption:
Figure 4: Overview of our SM4RT. Given a monocular input video, SM4RT extracts latent geome-
try tokens with a DINOv2 backbone, then decouples them into scene geometry and motion geometry
tokens. The scene decoder predicts camera parameters and depth, while the motion decoder esti-
mates sparse se(3) transforms and motion base weights for dense SE(3) projection.
delegated_acceptance_review: Viewed final SM4RT diagram and read caption/checks. Both encoder/decoder branches, six downward injection arrows, camera/depth and motion/base heads, original camera/depth/point-cloud evidence, se(3)/SE(3) notation and projection remain exact. Added title and two footer descriptions directly restate caption decoupling and output roles, without new transforms or coordinate definitions.
